1101: Information on the available Edge commands
1105:
/Add-Edge 
  [/SupportPath:<path-to-directory>]

  Adds Edge to image.

    Example:
      DISM.exe /Image:C:\test\offline /Add-Edge /SupportPath:C:\support
1108:
/Add-EdgeBrowser 
  [/SupportPath:<path-to-directory>]

  Adds Edge browser to image.

    Example:
      DISM.exe /Image:C:\test\offline /Add-EdgeBrowser /SupportPath:C:\support
1111:
/Add-EdgeWebView 
  [/SupportPath:<path-to-directory>]

  Adds Edge WebView to image.

    Example:
      DISM.exe /Image:C:\test\offline /Add-EdgeWebView /SupportPath:C:\support
1114:
/Remove-Edge 

  Removes Edge from image.

    Example:
      DISM.exe /Image:C:\test\offline /Remove-Edge
1117:
/Remove-EdgeBrowser 

  Removes Edge browser from image.

    Example:
      DISM.exe /Image:C:\test\offline /Remove-EdgeBrowser
1120:
/Remove-EdgeWebView 

  Removes Edge WebView from image.

    Example:
      DISM.exe /Image:C:\test\offline /Remove-EdgeWebView
